LESSON: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING- COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we tell the meaning of words and phrases in a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main ideas in a text
2. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of words in a text
3. describe characters, ideas, or events in a text
4. appreciate the importance of reading comprehension in lifelong learning

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING- COMPREHENSION
This lesson teaches Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the main ideas in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of words in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. describe characters, ideas, or events in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the importance of reading comprehension in lifelong learning
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension above.
2. Explain Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we tell the meaning of words and phrases in a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main ideas in a text
2. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of words in a text
3. describe characters, ideas, or events in a text
4. appreciate the importance of reading comprehension in lifelong learning

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
